provenance: family econ_tools, built by Claude for BIE on 5 November 2026 from the Sloman economics book's chapter needs (43 needs, 482 beats: formula builder, balance and seesaw, cause chain, sorter, spectrum and pendulum, ceteris paribus padlocks, tug of war, one versus all, T-account, choice paths, income line, doorway); drawn by code in families/econ_tools.mjs

formula.what: a formula built at the voice's speed: terms arrive one by one (operators come with the next term), fractions, Δ, powers and subscripts, letters that flip into numbers with a strike-and-write (or numbers that drop under the terms), working lines, a boxed result that can compute itself, Hindi labels under symbols, a glowing term; beam mode puts both sides of an identity on a balance that levels when they are equal (MV = PY)

terms.what: the formula as terms separated by |, e.g. PED|=|%ΔQ//%ΔP or P_1|=|a − c − bt//b + d; a//b (or {a}//{b}) is a fraction, x^2 or d^{t} a power, U_t a subscript, * becomes ×

upto.what: terms shown (1, 2, 3 ... in steps; an operator arrives with the term after it); 0: all

values.what: substitutions: letter=number (P=10;a=120) and term-number:text (3:2×10); a two-letter product like bt takes b and t

sub.what: in: the letters flip into their numbers in place; under: the numbers drop into chips under the terms; empty: letters only

result.what: the boxed result after =; auto: computed from the right-hand side with the values

unit.what: added to the result (₹ or $ go in front)

lines.what: working lines separated by ; (each may start with = to line up under the first =), e.g. = {110}//{20}

labels.what: words under terms: term-number:label;... e.g. 1:सीमांत उपयोगिता;3:दाम

beam.what: both sides on a beam balance that tips by their values and levels when equal (needs sub and values)

tiltFrom.what: beam mode: the tilt before this step (-1..1); empty: level

glide.what: seconds the beam takes to settle

color.what: the colour of numbers and the result

scaleBalance.what: a tarazu (two hanging pans) or a seesaw (a plank on a pivot) that tips by what is put on it: things (words or library drawings like @coinStack) drop into the pans one by one, values on the pans, the beam settles to its tilt (given, or auto from the weights), a tick on the winner, a level tag when it balances (MB = MC), a red gap block (scarcity); seesaw extras: a burden weight that slides by share (who bears a tax, with each side's part), a label on the pivot (a bond's fixed coupon)

left.what: things in the left pan separated by ; ('text', 'text=weight', '@coinStack' or '@moneyBag:label=2' for a library drawing)

order.what: the order things arrive in, e.g. L1,R1,L2; empty: all left then all right

upto.what: things arrived so far, in that order (the newest drops in after the step); 0: all

leftValue.what: a value on the left pan (₹400, 60%); its number counts as the weight in auto

tilt.what: -1: left side fully down, +1: right side fully down

tiltFrom.what: the tilt before this step (-1..1); empty: level, or (auto) the state before the newest thing

auto.what: tilt from the weights (values, else the things' weights)

glide.what: seconds the beam takes to settle

weight.what: seesaw: a burden weight on the plank (कर ₹10); the plank then tips by share

share.what: seesaw weight: the part borne by the left side (1: all on the left)

shareFrom.what: the value before this step (it glides from here after the step); empty: no glide

split.what: seesaw weight: show each side's part (₹7 and ₹3, or %)

pivotLabel.what: seesaw: a label on the pivot (₹10 हर साल)

mark.what: a tick above that side (auto: the heavier one)

levelTag.what: shown when the beam is level (MB = MC)

gapLabel.what: a red block above the pivot (दुर्लभता, net gain)

causeChain.what: a mechanism told as a chain: chips with up/down badges light one by one with arrows that draw themselves (rate up → EMI up → buyers down → prices down), subscripts in chips (D_g), the chain still to come shown faint, an optional loop back from the last chip to the first (wage-price spiral, self-fulfilling expectations) with a token running round, an 'until X = Y' stamp at the end, a second row joined to a chip (goods market to factor market); laid out in a row, a snake of two rows or a ring

links.what: chips in order: text|up, text|down, text|eq or text, separated by ;

links2.what: a second row of chips (another market), joined below chip 'join'

join.what: the chip of the first row the second row hangs from; 0: the last

at.what: chips lit so far (first row, then second); 0: all

ghost.what: show the chips still to come, faint

loop.what: an arrow from the last chip back to the first

loopLabel.what: a word on the loop arrow (फिर से)

until.what: the end condition stamped once every chip is lit (जब तक D_g = S_g)

layout.what: auto: a row up to 5 chips, else a snake

run.what: a token keeps running along the lit arrows

sorter.what: a classification as a game: a deck of cards, the next one big at the top; on each step a card flies into its labelled bin and gets a tick, or lands in a wrong bin, gets a cross and moves to the right one (macro or micro, positive or normative, land, labour or capital, a cost or not)

cards.what: cards separated by ;, each 'short|long statement' or one text

answers.what: the right bin of each card, 1-based, separated by commas (1,2,1)

wrong.what: cards that first land in a wrong bin: card:bin;... (2:1)

at.what: cards sorted so far (the newest flies after the step)

spectrum.what: a line between two poles with many labelled pins that drop in one by one and slide between two dated states (economies from planned to free market, 1980 to the late 2010s; schools of thought); as a pendulum, a bob under a clock swings between the two poles, the era named above and a flash at the end it reaches

pins.what: name:value;... (values between min and max; pendulum: -1..1)

pins2.what: name:value for the second state (pins not named stay)

state.what: 2: the pins slide to pins2 after the step and the date turns to date2

upto.what: pins shown (the newest drops in); 0: all

at.what: pendulum: the bob's place, -1 left pole, 1 right pole

atFrom.what: pendulum: the value before this step (it glides from here after the step); empty: no glide

era.what: pendulum: the era named above the clock

leftNote.what: pendulum: a flash at the left end while the bob is there (a crisis)

glide.what: seconds of the slide or swing

padlocks.what: ceteris paribus: labelled tags each held by a padlock; the tags in open have sprung free, the glowing one animates on its step (springs open, or snaps shut)

glow.what: the tag being told (it animates after the step)

tugOfWar.what: two teams pulling a rope over a share: the rope and teams move with the left team's share (shown on a bar above), the pulling team leans and the rope jerks on its step, and a price tag climbs one notch a round (wage-price spiral, conflict over national income)

shareFrom.what: the value before this step (it glides from here after the step); empty: no glide

rounds.what: rounds so far: the tag climbs a notch each

prices.what: the tag's text per round separated by ; (₹100;₹110;₹121)

shareLabel.what: the words over the share bar

shareNumbers.what: show the two % numbers on the share bar (false: the bar alone)

oneVsAll.what: the fallacy of composition: left panel, one actor does something and gains (or loses); right panel, the whole crowd copies it and the total's result tag flips the other way

stage.what: 0: both panels waiting, 1: the one acts, 2: everyone acts and the tag flips

total.what: the words over the crowd's result (कुल आमदनी)

tAccount.what: a balance sheet as an open ledger: liabilities on the left page, assets on the right, rows that enter on cue in their order, amounts struck and rewritten, totals that recount with a tick when they match, a capital cushion under the left page that a loss presses down (and breaks), a net-worth row that balances a household's sheet

left.what: rows label:amount;... on the left page

order.what: the order rows enter, e.g. L1,R1,R2; empty: L1,R1,L2,R2...

upto.what: rows entered so far (the newest slides in); 0: all

was.what: old amounts struck beside the new ones: L1:1,000;...

totals.what: the Σ row and the match tick

net.what: a net-worth row on the left that balances the sheet

capital.what: a capital cushion under the left page (0: none)

loss.what: a loss that drops on the cushion

choicePaths.what: opportunity cost: paths from one start to 2-4 options; the chosen path draws itself and gets a tick, the others fade, the best forgone option keeps a glow and a tag

incomeLine.what: a threshold over a population: people standing on bars at their incomes, a line across that counts and shades those below; relative mode puts the line at a share of the average and moves it as everyone gets richer (rise)

share.what: relative mode: the line as a share of the average

riseFrom.what: the value before this step (it glides from here after the step); empty: no glide

max.what: the top of the scale; 0: automatic

countLabel.what: the count of people below; {n} is the number

meanLabel.what: relative mode: the average line's name

doorway.what: a threshold concept as a door frame with a step: the door swings open on the word and the view beyond (a word) grows clear; a person can be walked across it

openFrom.what: the opening before this step; empty: shut

beyond.what: what is seen beyond once open
